text_to_speech: My children, the world has shared a message with me: The path to paradise is ready to be open. When reality is a dumpster fire… Run! Fuck! You start to believe it when they talk about “Paradise.” We wanted to believe it. We needed something to believe in. Being alone in this hellscape left us only two choices: Look out! Join her fucked-up cult... or join these guys. She just takes and takes and takes. And now they're holding captive who I love most... and I’m not gonna stop... - off of me! until I bring my brother home. That crazy bitch may be out for blood, but see, I don't turn in work half-assed. I'm a type A to the letter. I'll take their paradise and burn it all to the ground. Oh, that's Jeff. He's with me. Used electrodes to modify his behavior. AP bio really came in handy. Holly! Watch out! Everywhere the mother goes, a river of blood follows. But she and I, we have one thing in common, cross us, and we’ll stop at nothing until we fuck you up. We shall reach our true potential... That was fire. in Paradise!

youtube_description:
Everywhere she goes, a River of Blood flows…

Out now, “River of Blood” features 5 new chapters to make up Act 6 along with new Cleaner Tala, a friendly Tallboy named Jeff, new weapons, 12 exclusive weapon skins, 8 exclusive Cleaner skins, new cards, and a new Ridden foe. The expansion will coincide with the release of a new co-op game mode “Trial of the Worm”,  a free update for all who own Back 4 Blood. Experience the continued saga of the Cultists and Tala’s journey to save her brother and get revenge TODAY.

Please note, all playable content included in the River of Blood expansion will be accessible by all players in a party as long as one player in that party has purchased the expansion.

Available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One consoles, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4 and PC.
